properties.summary: Action: Final rule; stay. The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) is extending the suspension of the interim final rule (IFR), "Expansion of End-User Controls to Cover Affiliates of Certain Listed Entities." The suspension was set to end November 9, 2026. This final rule extends the suspension through January 10, 2027. Effective 2026-11-09. Later dates named in its DATES paragraph: 2027-01-10. Federal Register document 2026-22793.

The list now holds 8380 entries. This is the difference between two of Headwind's readings since Headwind's reading of 2026-11-24, seen on 2026-11-24; the dates of the designations are in the publisher's own notices. Added: NAZZARO, Rinaldo (individual, UE personnes impliquées dans des actes de terrorisme). Names as the publisher prints them, with type, programs and the countries of the entry's addresses and nationality; birth dates, identity documents, street addresses and reasons are not carried.
